oracle.independence_basis: Multinomial delta method with exact forward-mode derivatives over rationals on the saturated 8-cell (X2,M,Y) table: covariance of [mean0, mean1, contrast] times N, compared entrywise with the fixture at 1e-12; cell counts verified integral at N=16000. The generator uses dual-number differentiation of the Verma functional on cell probabilities and the multinomial covariance, which is neither the stratified block algebra written in the README nor the product's inversion of the 11-parameter expected Fisher information. The saturation of the 8-cell parameterization and the Verma functional itself are shared modelling statements.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README and the asserting test (which restates the stratified algebra); no product implementation source was consulted. Authorship of the original algebra is unrecorded.

reference_review.scope: One selected binary Verma model at N=16000; asymptotic covariance of the maximum-likelihood do-means and their contrast.
